descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
We are looking for an experienced QE Automation Lead / Senior Test Automation Engineer to join our Testing Chapter and strengthen automation capabilities across a complex, real-time, API-driven platform.
 The role will focus on enhancing and maintaining an existing Python-based test automation framework , expanding automated regression coverage, improving test evidence and quality reporting, and reducing manual testing effort. You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QE teams to establish sustainable, automation-first testing practices and improve overall release confidence.
 The role is hands-on and combines test automation engineering, quality leadership, framework development, risk-based testing, and stakeholder collaboration .
 Key Responsibilities 
Lead and contribute to the delivery of test automation initiatives across multiple squads.
Enhance, maintain, and extend the existing Python-based test automation framework .
Automate existing manual regression and functional test packs.
Identify test coverage gaps and implement automation to address critical quality risks.
Design and execute API, integration, functional, regression, and end-to-end testing .
Develop automated tests for RESTful APIs and complex system integrations.
Validate JSON/XML payloads, HTTP responses, authentication mechanisms, and database data .
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and quality gates.
Analyse test results, defects, and quality metrics to provide evidence-based release recommendations.
Work with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QE teams to define acceptance criteria and testing strategies.
Support risk-based test planning and identify potential quality and delivery risks.
Establish repeatable test evidence and improve visibility through dashboards and reporting.
Mentor and coach QA/QE engineers and developers on automation best practices.
Promote sustainable, squad-owned testing and automation practices.
Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, frameworks, tooling, and quality standards.
 Essential Skills & Experience 
 3–8+ years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or test automation.
Strong hands-on experience in test automation , preferably using Python.
Strong experience with Python test automation frameworks such as Pytest or similar.
Solid experience with RESTful API testing and automation .
Experience with functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
Experience creating and maintaining automated regression test suites.
Strong understanding of risk-based testing and test coverage analysis .
Experience working with Git and CI/CD environments.
Experience with JSON, XML, HTTP, and API authentication .
Good understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
 Technical Skills 
 Programming: Python
 API: REST, HTTP, JSON, XML, API authentication
 Automation: Pytest or equivalent Python automation frameworks
 CI/CD: Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar
 Version Control: Git
 Test Management: TestRail, Jira, or similar tools
 Database: SQL and database validation
 Architecture: Microservices, API-driven systems, integrations
 Reporting: Test coverage, defect analytics, quality dashboards, and release evidence
 Desirable Experience 
Experience working with real-time, event-driven, or high-volume transaction systems .
Experience with performance or load testing.
Experience with microservices-based architectures.
Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies.
Experience working with complex API integrations.
Experience with SQL/database automation and validation.
Experience coaching developers or QA engineers on automation practices.
Experience working within a Testing Chapter, Centre of Excellence, or similar operating model .
 Leadership & Behavioural Competencies 
Strong ownership of quality and automation outcomes.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with distributed squads.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to challenge existing approaches and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Strong attention to detail and a risk-based approach to quality.
Ability to mentor and influence engineers without relying solely on formal authority.
Collaborative and proactive mindset.
 Ways of Working 
Embedded within Agile delivery squads.
 Automation-first approach to regression testing.
Risk-based test planning and prioritisation.
Test evidence linked to quality gates and release decisions.
Close collaboration with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QE teams.
Continuous improvement of automation coverage, framework quality, and release assurance.
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate is a hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer or QE Lead who combines strong Python automation expertise with API testing, CI/CD, database validation, and quality engineering experience. They should also be comfortable providing technical guidance and coaching to other engineers while working within a complex, enterprise-scale Agile environment.
